body:
Complete route-by-route adoption of the shared OPF workflow without changing each site's look and feel. Essential work stays offline; preserve source formatting, validation, undo/redo and last-valid preview. Package adoption is separate from feature acceptance.

Updated 21 September 2026 after App53 merge and canonical production checks. The published train remains core **0.11.0**, CLI/renderer **0.9.0**, PPTX **0.9.1** and editor **0.8.0**, on Node 24. **Keep this issue open**: [App53](https://github.com/Data-Advantage/pptx-dev/pull/53) is deployed at `e40c287b64fcbcfb85fb4a8a50641aea8e3e54a8`, tree `64a0dbd702f43c87206c8a9fe16d06fe3ac68800`, identical to reviewed b33dc18. Before/after receipts bind the same READY canonical production deployment `dpl_hAEEDrxu746MBtDCHUh7z4bYaaLk`. The fresh canonical browser run passed **29/29**, zero retries. Premerge Linux/Windows application and artifact CI passed, but **postmerge application CI failed on Linux (28/29)** while Windows passed 29/29. Both platforms passed 627 unit tests; separate postmerge artifact CI passed. Production success does not replace the failed Linux gate. Earlier app45 14/18, app46 11/19 and app47 23/24 canonical failures remain retained.

- [x] Verify openpresentation.org `/` and `/playground` baseline: thirteen workflows covering edit directions, source formatting, contextual options, undo/redo, metadata, offline and mobile recovery.
- [x] Verify gallery layout-card/detail Playground and Editor links and config handoff. Gallery35/36 are merged and canonical docs-to-editor checks pass at `f17e9ae5869669d5fbac3720f285652d0c37551c`.
- [x] Replace stale current public guidance. Core93/97/98 are merged; quickstart/matrix/current API guides describe the published train. Site43/44 are merged and canonical `a85bcc77d899ce9ba1df659548be564142c16120` passes 321 checks across 11 pages and 18 raw resources, plus actual agent clipboard/skill bytes and OPF/SVG/PPTX downloads. The full guide includes complete Markdown guides with evidence links and preserves raw resource bytes. Historical evidence and immutable CLI bundled skills remain explicitly scoped.
- [x] Implement all-slide Inspector editing, minimal JSON source changes with exact undo/redo, stale-draft cancellation, render recovery and accessible font notes. [App45](https://github.com/Data-Advantage/pptx-dev/pull/45) merged as `e37e0da19671178da482bbe52cfd642419b670b5`; Linux and Windows pre/post-merge CI passed. Canonical READY deployment: `dpl_BcdbKFRoReTjKbQnMQ2e4NZSVask`.
- [x] Deploy the focused explicit-paste correction. [App46](https://github.com/Data-Advantage/pptx-dev/pull/46) merged as `c558dcc3a2e362bc238eb433a2db97fa682dfcc8` with the identical reviewed tree, green Linux/Windows pre/post-merge CI and canonical READY deployment `dpl_AGzL3mmPqZ5giiQWzh9EqyDPF8SX`. The old-build regression reproduces a 302→443 byte rewrite; the fixed local build preserves all 302 and explicit Format Document/undo. Local622 unit/19 browser checks pass. No package version changed.
- [ ] Complete app readiness and preservation acceptance. The current bounded canonical suite passes 29/29. Postmerge [application CI35633321018](https://github.com/Data-Advantage/pptx-dev/actions/runs/35633321018) fails Linux 28/29: after the shared-load toast, the security test sees five default-deck overlays instead of the one-slide imported fixture and stops on strict locator resolution before security assertions. Retained trace URLs also prove a separate wrong-hash publication while the source held the imported fixture; a stale deferred encode is inferred. App54 addresses that boundary but remains unmerged because its first Windows CI attempt timed out during later Author readiness (30/31; Linux31/31). This is distinct from the earlier Windows toast timeout. No test rerun or relaxed assertion replaces the failed result. Broader source writers and preset history remain open.
- [x] Deploy and verify the bounded focused-editor Ctrl+Space correction. App53 invokes the supported public Suggest action for exact Ctrl+Space with actual editor text focus. Local29/29, premerge Linux/Windows29/29 and canonical29/29 include the original LF third-popup flow and keyboard boundary controls. Diagnostics observed stale Quick Input context blocking OPF provider invocation; the competing internal command is inferred from installed source. Ten post-fix diagnostic scenarios captured no stale context, so causal stress remains inconclusive. Earlier Loading/readiness observations are not retrospectively explained. Existing suggestion-details clipping remains unresolved.
- [x] Correct the Monaco completion-range adapter defect. [App47](https://github.com/Data-Advantage/pptx-dev/pull/47) maps scalar and disjoint additional edits, retains authored whitespace, omits unchanged values, and invalidates stale catalogs/source. Installed Monaco validates 1,829 alternatives across 59 positions, and all five new canonical completion checks pass with exact source/undo behavior. This correction did not resolve the separate missing popup.
- [ ] Resolve broader source-preservation boundaries and destructive preset history. App53 ships bounded Author canvas/Copy/export and Inspector JSON-download preservation plus the order-only reimport-history correction. Canonical saved artifacts include 28 literal-byte JSON checks, one semantic imported-document check, one captured-byte import redo check and one PPTX; original imported-file formatting is not guaranteed. Separate local negative controls confirm that preset Undo all can replace both a New run presentation and an imported presentation with the preceding deck. A guarded fix is being prepared and is not accepted or released. Author metadata/filename/gallery/preset serialization, original imported-file bytes, account/agent paths and suggestion-details clipping remain open. Prior local24/27, local26/27 and old-head Windows26/27 failures are preserved. Successful pre/postmerge Windows timing uploads retained only Author data; the Inspector/pagehide snapshot is missing, so those timings do not explain the earlier readiness failures.

Retained-trace follow-up: decoded Linux trace URLs prove that automatic Inspector hash sync published the five-slide starter while the source held the imported one-slide fixture. The wrong hash was observed for at least 511.236 ms. Permanent persistence and a browser refresh were not measured; loading that captured address would decode the starter. A stale deferred encoder is the inferred mechanism, not an instrumented scheduler result. The original [App54](https://github.com/Data-Advantage/pptx-dev/pull/54) candidate at `60c91f6b97c75636f533202f4112e09dc01144e4`, implements a source-bound publication guard and fixture-identity readiness check. Local659 unit/full31 browser checks pass. [First-attempt CI35638158483](https://github.com/Data-Advantage/pptx-dev/actions/runs/35638158483) passed Linux31/31 but failed Windows30/31;659 unit tests passed on each. Both new publication/refresh cases passed on each platform. The Windows security test reached the unchanged45s limit during Author readiness after a31.4s navigation with a30.026s localhost script-resource delay. Inspector security assertions passed before navigation; later Author assertions completed only after the deadline. The after-hook did not originate the timeout, and the delivery/scheduling cause remains unproven. Original failed artifacts remain retained; no rerun replaced the result. App54 stays unmerged and has no canonical production acceptance. Explicit Inspector toolbar source freshness is addressed in the newer candidate below and remains pending release acceptance.

Original audit and preserved observations: [PR93 evidence](https://github.com/OpenPresentation/opf/blob/937047ff9f65d936126c577d3c6b7c5f9a61e364/docs/evidence/shipped-train-20260921/production/REPORT.md). [Current main handoff](https://github.com/OpenPresentation/opf/blob/84e914710520a7b0e777fce30e5758ee64a64924/docs/handoff-2026-09-21.md) and its linked evidence retain merged-source, platform CI, deployment, failed-run and follow-up receipts. [App53 source evidence](https://github.com/Data-Advantage/pptx-dev/tree/b33dc18e8c35803386feb80e7822f240a9671243/docs/evidence/author-source-preservation-20260921) and [keyboard diagnosis/acceptance evidence](https://github.com/Data-Advantage/pptx-dev/tree/b33dc18e8c35803386feb80e7822f240a9671243/docs/evidence/completion-keyboard-20260921) belong to the accepted App53 tree. Premerge [application CI35631886222](https://github.com/Data-Advantage/pptx-dev/actions/runs/35631886222) passed both platforms on attempt 1; postmerge artifact CI35633321013 also passed both platforms. Core102 retains the canonical and failed postmerge receipts; both of its pre/postmerge OPF and coordinated ecosystem CI runs passed. Core104 retains App54's held Windows result; its two premerge checks passed. Postmerge OPF passed and coordinated CI was canceled when descendant native-evidence core105 merged. Core105's fresh OPF/coordinated checks then passed; the distinct outcomes remain recorded. Do not treat source merge, npm publication, browser checks or native application acceptance as interchangeable.

Out of scope here: native Office/p:hf [#87](https://github.com/OpenPresentation/opf/issues/87), renderer [issue24](https://github.com/OpenPresentation/opf-render/issues/24) at the unchanged **0.1px** gate, and the coordinated geometry drafts (core94/render27/editor25/PPTX42/site40). Do not merge site40 alone. The broader developer-ready goal remains open.


Current App54 candidate — 21 September 2026: corrected head `6dfc2584698c1306505929a2bc3e427996d66563`, tree `f3279495f7685945b7541c90d24f7239407639a0`, preserves the original head and failed Windows evidence. It commits active public canvas drafts and captures current raw source for Copy/JSON/Share/PPTX/PDF/Author/Deckchat, retains rejected-draft errors through session recovery, and suppresses stale late output. Portable local startup now uses the packaged standalone server; this does not establish the cause or resolution of the old Windows asset delay. Package pins remain unchanged.

Fresh local Node24.21.0 acceptance passes692 unit tests,7 standalone controls, focused8/8 and full39/39 browser cases (113.565407s, zero retries), with four reviewed final screenshots. [Durable evidence](https://github.com/Data-Advantage/pptx-dev/tree/6dfc2584698c1306505929a2bc3e427996d66563/docs/evidence/inspector-action-snapshots-20260921) includes both original diagnostic failure traces. The first focused7/8 result remains: the test initiated paste without establishing accepted new input before releasing a held PDF401 response. Final tests observe the new Monaco text before release, with no extra toolbar action, preview wait or product change. CRLF paste normalization and locally mocked PDF/Deckchat boundaries are explicit. Fresh exact-head Linux/Windows CI is now pending; App54 is unmerged and this head has no production acceptance. App53 remains the current production baseline, and issue88 remains open.

The intermediate57e5e59 failed its first [Linux/Windows CI35645493900](https://github.com/Data-Advantage/pptx-dev/actions/runs/35645493900): each passed692 unit tests and7 startup controls, then TypeScript discovered two archived `.ts` evidence snapshots with unresolved relative imports. App builds and browser stages did not run. Its preview also reports `module_not_found`; precise preview compiler logs were unavailable. The correction retains identical snapshot bytes as `.ts.txt`, leaves all305 product/test inputs unchanged, and passes final-tree local TypeScript. Original logs and metadata are committed under `packaging-failure/`; fresh exact6dfc258 platform and preview checks are pending. The earlier local39/39 build preceded evidence assembly and does not override the failed intermediate commit.
